title: My Body Picture Song
hook: One body clue is never the whole body.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D body-learning storybook, non-graphic anatomy models and everyday wellness cues, clean shapes; visual identity: My Body Picture Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child mapping body structure and function
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make My Body Picture Song a structure-and-function map: joint, muscle, organ, hand anatomy, vision and imaging are linked without treating the body as a machine with one part-one job.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child moves from visible body regions to hidden systems and models, learning that functions emerge from structures working together.
